{{Quote|I'm going in closer to one of the big ones.|Han Solo|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''Big One''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]]-sized [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] located in the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used a large crater within this asteroid to hide his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], from pursuing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under the command of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. However, Solo and his [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] companions, including [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], were surprised to learn that the large asteroid crater was actually the gullet of an enormous [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]]. Vader, having anticipated that the ''Millennium Falcon'' had most likely hid inside one of the asteroids, also deployed TIE/sa bombers to bomb the area to flush them out.
